cu: 46. [Area: Customer Decision Making] [Role: Customer] [Action: compare multiple products side by side] [Purpose: to make better purchase decisions]
rf: 6. [Module: Product Details] [Function: display product details] [Trigger: user selects product] [Behavior: system shall show detailed description, images, reviews, etc.]
test_case:
Title: Compare Multiple Products Side by Side Functionality Test - Customer Decision Making

Objective: To verify that the system allows customers to compare multiple products side by side for better purchase decisions, and displays detailed product information when a product is selected.

Preconditions:
1. A registered user is logged in.
2. Multiple products are available in the system with detailed descriptions, images, reviews, etc.
3. The "Compare Products" feature is enabled and accessible.
4. The user has navigated to the product comparison page.

Test Steps:
1. Log in as a registered user.
2. Navigate to the product listing page.
3. Select three different products that are available for comparison.
4. Click on the "Compare Products" button or link.
5. Verify that the system displays a new page with the selected products arranged side by side.
6. Verify that each product has its detailed description, images, reviews, etc., displayed.
7. Verify that the user can switch between the compared products easily.
8. Verify that the system calculates and displays any relevant comparison metrics (e.g., price, ratings, etc.) for each product.
9. Verify that the user can remove a product from comparison if needed.
10. Verify that the system saves the selected products for future reference during the same session.

Expected Result: The system allows customers to compare multiple products side by side and displays detailed product information when a product is selected, making it easier for them to make better purchase decisions.

cu: 13. [Area: E-commerce] [Role: Customer] [Action: receive email confirmation] [Purpose: to have proof of purchase]
rf: 13. [Module: Order Tracking] [Function: track order status] [Trigger: user checks order status] [Behavior: system shall provide updates on delivery progress]
test_case:
- Title: Customer receives email confirmation for an order and can track its status via Order Tracking module
- Objective: To verify that a customer receives an email confirmation upon placing an order and is able to track the order's status using the Order Tracking module.
- Preconditions:
  - A valid user account has been created with necessary details (email, password).
  - The user has placed an order successfully on the e-commerce platform.
  - The email server is functioning correctly and delivering emails to the specified recipient.

- Test Steps:
  1. Log in to the e-commerce platform using a valid customer account.
  2. Navigate to the 'Orders' section of the user dashboard.
  3. Verify that the most recent order is not showing any status updates yet.
  4. Check the email associated with the customer account for any new messages.
  5. Open the received email and verify it contains details about the placed order, including product information, order number, and a link to track the order's status.
  6. Click on the provided 'Track Order Status' link from the email.
  7. Navigate back to the e-commerce platform and refresh the orders page.
  8. Verify that the most recent order now shows updates on its delivery progress using the Order Tracking module.

- Expected Result: The customer receives an email confirmation with order details and a link to track the status, and upon clicking the link, they can view updates on their order's delivery progress via the Order Tracking module.

cu: 26. [Area: E-commerce Administration] [Role: Administrator] [Action: view and manage orders] [Purpose: to ensure delivery]
rf: 13. [Module: Order Tracking] [Function: track order status] [Trigger: user checks order status] [Behavior: system shall provide updates on delivery progress]
test_case:
Title: Administrator - View and Manage Orders - Order Tracking - Check Order Status

Objective: To verify that the administrator can view order details, including tracking information, and that the system provides updates on delivery progress.

Preconditions:
1. The administrator has logged into the E-commerce Administration system successfully.
2. There are existing orders in the system.
3. The orders have valid tracking numbers associated with them.
4. The shipping carrier is integrated with the system and providing updates.

Test Steps:
1. Log in to the E-commerce Administration system as an administrator.
2. Navigate to the Orders section.
3. Select one of the existing orders from the list.
4. Verify that the order details are displayed, including the tracking number.
5. Click on the "Track Order" button associated with the selected order.
6. Observe and record the delivery progress updates displayed on the screen.
7. Wait for a specified period (e.g., 1 hour) to ensure that the shipping carrier provides updates.
8. Refresh the page and verify that the latest delivery progress update is displayed.
9. Repeat steps 6-8 at regular intervals to confirm continuous updates.

Expected Result:
1. The administrator can view order details, including tracking information.
2. Clicking on the "Track Order" button displays the delivery progress updates.
3. The system provides updates on delivery progress in real-time or near real-time, reflecting the carrier's updates.

cu: 39. [Area: Customer Behavior] [Role: Customer] [Action: use coupons or discount codes] [Purpose: to get benefits on purchases]
rf: 34. [Module: Promotions and Discounts] [Function: apply promotions or discounts] [Trigger: user applies coupon or discount code] [Behavior: system shall adjust purchase total accordingly]
test_case:
- Title: Apply Coupon/Discount Code Functionality Test
- Objective: To verify that the system correctly applies promotions or discounts when a user enters a valid coupon or discount code during checkout.
- Preconditions:
  - A registered customer is logged in to their account.
  - The customer has items in their shopping cart.
  - The system has active promotions or discount codes available for use.
- Test Steps:
  1. Log in as a registered customer.
  2. Navigate to the shopping cart page.
  3. Verify that the total price of the items in the cart is displayed correctly.
  4. Enter a valid coupon/discount code in the provided field.
  5. Click on the 'Apply' button.
  6. Verify that the system acknowledges the successful application of the coupon/discount code.
  7. Check the new total price of the items in the cart to ensure it has been adjusted accordingly based on the applied promotion or discount.
- Expected Result: The system should apply the entered coupon/discount code correctly, adjusting the purchase total according to the active promotion or discount rules. The customer should be able to proceed with the checkout process using the updated total price.
